name: Ring of the Hesitant Climber
body:
Aura faint transmutation; CL 5th; Slot ring; Weight –

DESCRIPTION

This ring appears to be a ring of climbing and functions as such. If the wearer is climbing more than 20 feet from the ground, she must make a DC 15 Will save or become panicked and fall. This saving throw must be made every round they wearer remains more than 20 feet above the ground.

This ring can be removed freely.

CONSTRUCTION REQUIREMENTS

Magic Items ring of climbing

Identification DC 30
False Identification DC 20
